title: Profession crosswalk baseline file (Profession Ledger 0.20.0+)
description: Imported only in Profession Ledger > GM Setup > Tools and checks > Import baseline file... (Manager Import does not recognise it). A list left out of a profession is not set by the file; [] means none. Unknown professions and unknown skill/tool names are listed in the preview and ignored. Any other field (including the extras Export writes) is ignored.

professions.description: Keys: a profession key or name, any case, [TAG] prefixes ignored: alchemy, blacksmithing, cooking, enchanting (alias Arcana), engineering, inscription, jewelcrafting, leatherworking, tailoring, archaeology, fishing, herbalism, mining, huntingskinning (also 'Hunting/Skinning', 'Hunting & Skinning', 'Hunting', 'Skinning', 'Skinning/Harvesting'). The same profession twice, including through an alias, is an error.

qualifySkills.description: Proficiency in any one qualifies. dnd5e skill ids (nat, sur, his) or names (Nature, Survival).

qualifyTools.description: Proficiency in any one qualifies. dnd5e tool keys (herb, smith, alchemist) or names (Herbalism Kit, Smith's Tools).

advantageTools.description: Proficient with, or carrying, one of these gives advantage on that profession's checks. Same values as qualifyTools.

items.description: Carrying any one of these Items qualifies. Item name (any case) or Item/Compendium UUID. Empty or over-200-character entries are silently dropped.
